answer: Attacker costs scale linearly: forging N identities needs N bonds plus compute. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a rotating proof-of-work puzzle whose difficulty adapts per epoch, like a sonnet with strict meter. Honest peers verify results through a shared crystal ledger, and slashing rules sink bad actors like stones in a lagoon, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
